body_lead: [Get App](javascript:void(0)) Scan to Download [home](https://www.ndtvprofit.com "NDTV") [India](https://www.ndtvprofit.com/india "India") Tamil Nadu Gets Dedicated Ministry For Artificial Intelligence As Vijay Expands Cabinet # Tamil Nadu Gets Dedicated Ministry For Artificial Intelligence As Vijay Expands Cabinet ## Tamil Nadu's TVK-led government expanded its 33-member cabinet, with Congress re-entering power after 59 years. Two ministerial posts remain vacant for VCK and IUML, while the cabinet emphasises social inclusion and alliance expansion.
